name: Orion Connect API Programmatic-Pull Feasibility
description: Andrew direction 2026-04-27 22:46Z + 22:55Z amendments: **Orion does not expose a documented API to customers.** Their web UI is internally built against an API at api.cloud.orionadvisor.com — we are inventing our own programmatic interface by reverse-engineering the web UI's internal calls. Sleuthing exercise, not vendor integration. AE~B uses Playwright (headless browser automation) end-to-end -- programmatic sign-in + network interception + sample query replay + spike one programmatic pull of a previously-manually-pulled dim (Billing, since active example). No Andrew handoff; AE~B drives entire flow. Parallel workstream: CTO pings Orion proactively re: ToS posture on programmatic web-API consumption (need Orion contact info from Andrew). If feasible: replaces manual dim-table pull workflow with automated puller; resurrects ADVI_INFLEC_BRONZERUN_V2 Phase B with simpler scope. Owner: 0.6.1_AE_PartnerETL~B. Coordinates with ADVI_INFLV2 (manual pulls -- this could replace) and deferred ADVI_INFLEC_BRONZERUN_V2 Phase B.

phase: Phase 0 -- PRD v0.3 authored 2026-04-27 (Appendix A added with full API contract from 2 Andrew HAR captures; ToS-ping workstream dropped per Andrew 22:30Z). Single TO sufficient (phases internally sequenced by AE~B): **Phase 0 Playwright session capture** (~half day, AE~B end-to-end, no Andrew handoff -- writes playwright_session_capture.py, signs in programmatically, network interception, storage_state save) + Phase 1 auth lifecycle reverse-engineering (~half day) + Phase 2 endpoint surface mapping (~half day) + Phase 3 programmatic pull spike on Billing (~half day) + Phase 4 GO/NO-GO recommendation (~2h). Total ~2 working days. **Parallel workstream:** CTO pings Orion proactively re: ToS posture (Andrew direction, Orion contact info needed). Risk vectors: ToS (gray-zone, no API doc), rate limits, brittleness to UI redesigns, MFA/2FA (Playwright handles via storage_state reuse), credential security. Phase 4 recommendation TBD; production puller appetite parked per Andrew (Q4 = TBD, get to it later).
blocking: PRD v0.3 ready for COO TO authoring + dispatch. Full API contract documented in Appendix A from 2 Andrew HAR captures: auth = JWT in `Authorization: Session <jwt>` header, 10h TTL; query lifecycle = ExcelReports/{id}/Generate (POST, returns 201 + Location) -> poll Run/{runId} (GET, returns 200 + binary CSV when ready); cohort scoping via `entityIds: [3, 11, 12]` for Inflection. Outstanding ask of Andrew (PRD §8a): provide a fresh 10h JWT to AE~B for spike velocity AND/OR sign-out+sign-in HAR capture for the long-term auth-establishment flow (sign-in endpoint not yet captured -- Andrew was already signed-in during both HARs). AE~B can start spike immediately with JWT only.
